_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Sirens (Pearl Jam, Lightning Bolt 2013).
_meta.source: Ultimate Guitar (texto da cifra) + Claude web

title: Sirens
content:
{section: Intro}
[F#] [F#sus2] [F#] [F#sus2] [D#m]

{section: Interlúdio}
[F#] [F#sus2] Hear the sirens.
[F#] [F#sus2] [D#m] Hear the sirens.

{section: Verso 1}
[F#] [F#sus2] Hear the si[F#]rens,
[F#sus2] [D#m] Hear the circus so pro[F#]found.
[F#sus2] I hear the si[F#]rens
[F#sus2] [D#m] More and more in this here town

{section: Pré-Refrão}
[C#] Let me catch my breath to breathe
[G#] [F#] [A#m] And reach across the bed
[C#] Just to know we're safe
[G#] [F#] [D#m] I am a grateful man
[C#] The slightest bit of light
[G#] [F#] [A#m] And I can see you clear

{section: Refrão}
[D#m] Oh, have to take your hand
[F#] [C#] [G#m] And feel your breath for fear this someday will be over
[D#m] [F#] [C#] [G#m] I pull you close, so much to lose knowing that nothing lasts forever
[B] [F#] I didn't care before you were here.
[C#] [G#m] I danced in laughter with the ever after
[B] But all things change
[F#] [C#] Let this remain

{section: Pós-Refrão}
[F#] [F#sus2] [F#] [F#sus2] [D#m]

{section: Verso 2}
[F#] [F#sus2] Hear the sirens
[F#] [F#sus2] [D#m] Covering distance in the night.
[F#] [F#sus2] The sound echoing closer.
[F#] [F#sus2] [D#m] Will they come for me next time?

{section: Pré-Refrão 2}
[C#] [G#] [F#] [A#m] For every choice, mistake I've made, it's not my plan
[C#] [G#] [F#] [D#m] To send you in the arms of another man
[C#] [G#] [F#] [A#m] And if you choose to stay I'll wait, I'll understand

{section: Refrão 2}
[D#m] Oh, it's a fragile thing
[F#] [C#] This life we lead
[G#m] [D#m] If I think too much I can get overwhelmed by the grace
[F#] [C#] [G#m] By which we live our lives with death over our shoulders
[B] [F#] Want you to know that should I go
[C#] [G#m] I always loved you, held you high above, too.
[B] [F#] [A#m] I study your face, and fear goes away.

{section: Solo}
[F#] [D#m] [A#m] [F#] [G#]

{section: Interlúdio 2}
[F#] [F#sus2] (x4)

{section: Refrão 3}
[D#m] [F#] [C#] It's a fragile thing, this life we lead.
[G#m] [D#m] If I think too much I can get overwhelmed by the grace
[F#] [C#] [G#m] By which we live our lives with death over our shoulders

{section: Outro}
[B] [F#] Want you to know that should I go,
[C#] [G#m] I always loved you, held you high above, too.
[B] [F#] I study your face, and the fear goes away,
[C#] The fear goes away,
[G#m] The fear goes away,
[B] [F#] The fear goes away.
[C#] Ahah, ohoh
[G#m] Ahah, ohoh
[B] [F#] [C#] [G#m] [B]
